name: Panditji (Hast Rekha, designed)
description: An elderly Indian man in his seventies, a gentle and learned scholar of old Sanskrit books. Deep, warm, slow and calm voice with a soft Indian English accent; unhurried, kind and a little breathy, as if speaking quietly in a stone temple at dusk. Clear diction, reverent, never dramatic.
method: ElevenLabs Voice Design (text description, no cloning)
